# Module: `icescopy_dialogs`

Input dialogs for session metadata, temperature import, and export selection.

[Source](../src/icescopy_dialogs.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Dialogs gather and validate user choices; parsing and count calculations belong to the temperature and freeze-count modules. `get_values()` results are consumed by the matching main-window import action.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`NewSessionMetadataDialog`](API-Class-NewSessionMetadataDialog.md) | Collects project, user, institution, and date metadata for a session. |
| [`CSUTemperatureImportDialog`](API-Class-CSUTemperatureImportDialog.md) | Collects a CSU Ice Spectrometer input file and import options. |
| [`UTKTemperatureImportDialog`](API-Class-UTKTemperatureImportDialog.md) | Collects UTK temperature data and video timing options. |
| [`TAMUTemperatureImportDialog`](API-Class-TAMUTemperatureImportDialog.md) | Collects TAMU Linkam temperature and optional calibration inputs. |
| [`PKUTemperatureImportDialog`](API-Class-PKUTemperatureImportDialog.md) | Collects a Linksys32 IML file and PKU import options. |
| [`StandardTemperatureImportDialog`](API-Class-StandardTemperatureImportDialog.md) | Collects standard CSV import choices and previews image timestamp parsing. |
| [`OutputResultsDialog`](API-Class-OutputResultsDialog.md) | Lets the user choose among the result exports currently available. |
